limitations: New recording coverage is only frames 0-1019 of 11271, not the complete 20-minute bag.
No independent exhaustive real labels: no real precision, recall, false-positive rate or verified identity-switch count.
Nearest-pair hypotheses can recur and do not establish physical identity or causality.
Path horizon covers lateral support; ground support, visibility and sweep validation remain separate.
Unverified sensor extrinsics, return/timing provenance, gauge and cant; deskew and longitudinal extension remain off.
Synthetic results cannot establish field safety and the 0.95 event-recall criterion still applies.
Processing times are single uncontrolled offline runs; baseline old run overlapped archive inspection; later runs sequential.
Distances measure sensor-frame x of observed support, not bumper or integrated along-track distance.

track_examples.selection: Post-hoc maximum minimum directed support-overlap per hypothesized cause in old panel; review aids, not labelled events.
